title: Captured Russian and Chinese weapons shown underground at Crane
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: they were telling us about the uh some Russian and Chinese weapon systems that were captured

plain: In 2014, at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy site in Indiana, Randy Anderson says he and others were taken underground and told about Russian and Chinese weapon systems that had been captured. Anderson, a man who says he saw alien technology at a military base, tells Michels this as something he witnessed. It is part of his account of what was kept out of sight at the base.
